text:
Carmen: Heads-up  Toronto AI Roundtable confirmed Dec 2. We have a tabletop, a 12-min microtalk slot, and a 20-min panel. Need owners for speaker submission, panel moderator, demo, swag, shipping, and lead routing. Shipping cutoff Nov 24. Who can pick speaker submission today?

Luis: I can submit the microtalk. Will condense our cost-vs-latency benchmark and include a 90s live prefix-cache demo. Any slide limit?

Nadia: Organizer note says 6 slides max for microtalk, panel bios due 72h before. Also no live API keys on stage.

Owen: I'll own AV + demo table. Request: 15" monitor, HDMI/USB-C dongles, 2 lavs, battery pack, extension cord, gaffer. I'll also be onsite lead for receiving.

Priya: Swag proposal: 200 stickers, 100 postcard leave-behinds, 60 branded travel mugs (insulated). Vendor: northshore-swag.co. PO #PO-8202. Mugs push budget  recommend postcards -> 80 to balance.

Carmen: Let's do stickers 200, postcards 80, mugs 60. Priya finalize order and ETA. Also we should prepare a 1-page micro-benchmark leave-behind + 3 integration tips for infra teams. Can someone draft copy by Nov 15?

Luis: I'll draft the one-pager along with slides. Need the latest perf PNGs (2-token baseline + 1k-tail). Can eng-runtime-bot upload?

eng-runtime-bot: Perf artifact uploaded: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/toronto_dec2_tail.png

Priya: Vendor ETA Nov 26 if order placed today. Tracking will be provided. I'll add hold-for-pickup notes and recipient "Owen / Redwood Inference". PO and invoice will be attached to the event sheet.

Carmen: Lead capture plan: QR -> short Typeform (name, email, company, interest tags) + badge scanner as fallback. Routing: Typeform webhook -> HubSpot list "Toronto Roundtable" -> assign to Nadia for first 48h -> then SDR rotation. Nadia can you own the Typeform and the Zap?

Nadia: Yep. Form fields set. Zapier draft:
```
trigger: typeform.webhook
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact
payload: {"properties":[{"property":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"property":"utm_source","value":"toronto_roundtable"},{"property":"owner","value":"Nadia"}]}
```
I'll test with a sandbox entry and confirm by Nov 18.

Luis: I'll add utm_source=toronto_roundtable&utm_campaign=dec2_demo to the demo link and QR. Also uploading a fallback recorded clip (no live keys) to the shared drive.

marketing-bot: Reminder: include a short workshop narrative on the landing page that highlights "predictable latency at 95th pct" and a benchmark callout. Suggested headline draft: "Serve LLMs with predictable latency and 3x lower token cost".

Carmen: Good call. We'll iterate messaging post-draft. Nadia please include utm params in the Typeform hidden fields. Owen please confirm arrival checklist and table layout.

Owen: Layout: monitor center, postcards left, stickers top-right, mugs under table in crate. Arrival checklist: monitor, dongles, lavs, power, backup USB with recorded demo, printed one-pagers (70), stickers, postcards, mugs. I'll be the onsite recipient.

Priya: Shipping carrier: HarborLine Express. Tracking HL99887766. I'll DM the courier to confirm hold and upload manifest to the sheet.

Carmen: Dry run Nov 30 @ 10am ET. Recap owners: Luis = microtalk + one-pager + demo link + fallback clip, Owen = AV + onsite + arrival checklist, Priya = swag order + shipping, Nadia = Typeform + Zap + leads routing, Carmen = runbook + messaging iteration. Quick Zap snippet above. Please update the event sheet and mark items as done when complete. :rocket:
